label: Cisco GLC-EX-SMD 1000BASE-EX 40 km
notes: Cisco SFP and SFP+ Transceiver Module Installation Notes, optical specifications table (GLC-EX-SMD): average launch -1.0..+3.0 dBm, receiver overload +1.0 dBm, sensitivity -22.0 dBm, 1290-1335 nm, 40 km on G.652 SMF, 18 dB maximum channel insertion loss. 1000BASE-EX is NOT an IEEE 802.3 class - it is a vendor long-reach convention - so this row cites the Cisco document that publishes it rather than a standard. The 21 dB between launch floor and sensitivity is not free headroom: the launch ceiling (+3 dBm) sits 2 dB above the receiver's own +1 dBm overload, which is why Cisco's note calls for a 5 dB inline attenuator on back-to-back or very short links - on a short span this optic fails on OVERLOAD, not on reach. Connector is dual LC/PC; APC is not supported. Replace these figures with the test report for the module actually purchased before pricing a build.
